title: Index construction exhausts the Node heap
root_cause: The workflow limits V8 old space to 32 MB while the indexing process retains batches in memory. Garbage collection cannot reclaim enough space and Node aborts with a heap exhaustion error.

relevant_evidence.why: Garbage collection fails to reclaim enough heap and Node reports an out-of-memory fatal error.
The command sets the V8 heap limit.
The process keeps all indexed records in memory.
